items.description: Role metadata — platforms (Ubuntu >= 18.04, CentOS >= 7.0), no external dependencies
items.notes: meta/main.yml already existed and was marked complete. Pending entry from metadata.rb resolved — existing file retained.

items.description: Role defaults — app path, git repo/branch, port, venv path, PostgreSQL DB/user/password variable, .env content, systemd service settings
items.notes: Created from hardcoded values in recipe. All credential variables use AAP-injected variables. fastapi_password replaced with db_password from AAP credential type.

items.description: Role argument specs for fail-fast parameter validation — generate after defaults/main.yml is written
items.notes: Generated from defaults/main.yml. Documents all role variables including AAP-injected credential variables (required: true, no default).

items.description: Main tasks — install system packages (python3, pip, venv, git, postgresql, postgresql-contrib, libpq-dev), create app directory, clone git repo, create venv, install pip deps, enable/start postgresql, provision DB user and database, write .env, write systemd unit, daemon-reload handler notify, enable/start fastapi-tutorial service
items.notes: Converted all Chef resources to Ansible tasks. validate_credentials.yml included first. systemctl daemon-reload is a handler. AAP credential variables used for DB provisioning. pip module used instead of execute for pip install.

items.description: Jinja2 template for /opt/fastapi-tutorial/.env — PROJECT_NAME, API_VERSION, DATABASE_URL with vaulted password variable. Mode 0644 (consider tightening to 0600).
items.notes: Converted inline heredoc from recipe to Jinja2 template. Uses AAP credential variable database_url and role defaults for project name and API version.

items.description: Jinja2 template for /etc/systemd/system/fastapi-tutorial.service — systemd unit with ExecStart uvicorn on port 8000, After=postgresql.service, Restart=always
items.notes: Converted inline heredoc from recipe to Jinja2 template. All hardcoded values replaced with role variables. Handler notified on change.

items.description: Handlers — systemctl daemon-reload (notified when fastapi-tutorial.service unit file changes)
items.notes: Created handlers for systemd daemon-reload and fastapi-tutorial service restart. Notified by systemd unit file template task.

items.description: Molecule scenario configuration — delegated driver, local connection (not docker/podman)
Molecule converge playbook — runs the fastapi_tutorial role via a single ansible.builtin.include_role task
items.notes: Includes fastapi_tutorial role via ansible.builtin.include_role. AAP credential variables (db_username, db_password, db_name, db_host, database_url) set as play vars so validate_credentials.yml passes in molecule context.

items.description: Molecule verify playbook — checks app dir (755), .env (644), systemd unit (644), venv/uvicorn binary, postgresql service active, fastapi-tutorial service active, port 8000 listening, HTTP 200 on /docs
items.notes: Split into 3 plays: (1) filesystem/venv/config file content checks, (2) service facts and port checks, (3) HTTP endpoint and PostgreSQL database checks. All loops use prefixed loop_var and bracket notation. No registered vars in fail_msg strings.
